deficiencies.description: The rewrite states 'when the tumour occurs in a meningioma', treating 'meningioma' as an anatomical location in which a tumour can occur. In fact, a meningioma is itself a tumour (arising from the meninges). In the original text, 'they're occurring in things like the meningioma... or in the liver' referred to 'these deaths' occurring in cases such as meningioma or liver cancer. Describing a tumour as occurring inside a meningioma is medically inaccurate and misleading for a student.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Only 10% of these deaths, generally, if they're occurring in things like the meningioma that I was telling you about or in the liver.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Only 10% of deaths are generally caused in this way, for example when the tumour occurs in a meningioma or in the liver.
